kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
يجتهد (form VIII)
# يَجْتَهِدُ (yajtahidu) /jad͡ʒ.ta.hi.du/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِجْتَهَدَ (ijtahada)
# يُجْتَهَدُ (yujtahadu) /jud͡ʒ.ta.ha.du/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِجْتَهَدَ (ijtahada)
# يَجْتَهِدَ (yajtahida) /jad͡ʒ.ta.hi.da/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِجْتَهَدَ (ijtahada)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
